name: Backdoor Account Creation
description: A HID payload deployed on an unattended workstation can create a local or domain account, add an account to privileged groups, or modify authentication settings to allow future logical access. This technique bridges the physical and cyber domains — the physical access enables the account creation, which then provides persistent access that does not require physical re-entry. Typically the highest-impact finding in engagements that include a cyber scope component.

blue.det: New local account in system logs; EDR alert on account creation; SIEM correlation with physical access event; unexpected privileged account.
blue.cm: Privileged Access Management (PAM); SIEM monitoring for new account creation; endpoint detection of local admin creation; regular account audits; workstation auto-lock.
